column3: Template error (policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5), on Swift Reckoning only: the general note on the ability word in the Magic Origins Release Notes (2015-07-08, under “New Ability Word: Spell Mastery”), written for spell mastery abilities that change what the spell does (Fiery Impulse’s, its example) and attached to every card with the ability word. Swift Reckoning’s spell mastery is a permission to cast it (“you may cast this spell as though it had flash”), judged as the casting begins with the card where it is (CR 601.3, 601.6a: cast from a graveyard, it counts itself) and of no effect as the spell resolves, as its own note says (“The number of instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard matters only as you begin to cast Swift Reckoning. ...”). The text stays cited for the cards it was written for (tests/rulings/r_s15_spell_mastery.rs); Swift Reckoning’s behavior: tests/cards/cast_permissions_classes.rs, swift_reckoning_flash_timing_with_spell_mastery; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md (work item ruling-conflicts-13, its review)
